tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces you belong to, with your role in each.

tools.name: set_active_workspace
tools.description: Switch your active workspace — the default scope for list/create/search when no workspace_id is passed.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in a workspace (defaults to your active workspace). Uses the same ?q=, folder, type, access, sort, and view params as the documents browse UI.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a document in a workspace. Use content_type markdown for prose; html only for full-page strategy decks per docs/HTML-SUBSET.md. Optionally seed initial content as the first commit.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read a document at primary or a named version line. Returns document.baseHash on the active line and a windowed snippet.

tools.name: read_at_commit
tools.description: Read a document body as of a specific commit hash.

tools.name: commit_document
tools.description: Save to primary or a version line. Protected documents block saves to primary — use submit_proposal instead, or save to a version line for intermediate work. Provide base_hash from your last read.

tools.name: submit_proposal
tools.description: Submit a primary proposal on Protected documents (write_mode: reviewed). Requires write access. Pass proposal_id to amend an existing open proposal (like pushing commits to a PR branch). Omit proposal_id to open a new proposal. After submit: a workspace peer approves (or owner bypasses), then anyone

tools.name: update_proposal
tools.description: Amend a pending or approved proposal on a Protected document. Resets approval to pending. Like pushing additional commits to an open PR branch — use when iterating on the same proposal rather than opening a parallel one.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List proposals on a document (default: open — pending or approved). Like gh pr list for Protected documents.

tools.name: read_proposal
tools.description: Read a proposal's proposed body (bounded excerpt, like read_document). Use diff_proposal to see changes vs primary.

tools.name: diff_proposal
tools.description: Diff a proposal against primary (what would change if published). Same preview shape as diff_commits.

tools.name: withdraw_proposal
tools.description: Withdraw (close without publishing) an open proposal. Any reader may withdraw pending or approved proposals — like closing a PR without merge.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List version lines on a document: primary plus named versions (draft/*). Version lines support multi-step work without racing primary.

tools.name: publish_version
tools.description: Publish a version line to primary on open documents. On protected documents, use submit_proposal with the version content instead — versions are a workbench for intermediate saves, not a direct path to primary.

tools.name: document_history
tools.description: Paginated commit history for a document (newest first).

tools.name: diff_commits
tools.description: Compare two saves line-by-line (a diff). Same +/− preview as after saving.

tools.name: rename_document
tools.description: Rename or move a document (needs edit access). Slashes are folders: "Research/Q3/plan" moves it into Research/Q3 (you need edit access there too). Moving changes who can see it — check list_access first. Title only — no file extension.

tools.name: archive_document
tools.description: Archive a document (owner or admin). Hides it from the active list; full history is kept. Prefer this over delete for inactive work.

tools.name: unarchive_document
tools.description: Restore an archived document to the active list (owner only).

tools.name: trash_document
tools.description: Move a document to trash (owner only). Recoverable for 30 days before auto-purge. Prefer archive for inactive work you may revisit.

tools.name: restore_document
tools.description: Restore a trashed document to the active list (owner only).

tools.name: purge_document
tools.description: Permanently delete a trashed document and its history (owner only). Document must already be in trash.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Alias for trash_document — moves a document to trash (owner only). Use purge_document for permanent deletion.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Full-text search across a workspace's documents (title + body).

tools.name: add_document_comment
tools.description: Add a comment on a document (Comments panel). Does not change document content.

tools.name: delete_document_comment
tools.description: Delete a document comment (author or document owner).

tools.name: resolve_document_comment
tools.description: Mark a document comment resolved or reopen it (author or document owner).

tools.name: read_workspace_context
tools.description: Read workspace standing instructions plus applicable Standards: rules/ markdown docs whose body starts with YAML frontmatter kind: rule (see document templates). Path alone is not enough.

tools.name: step_up_probe
tools.description: Diagnostic only: tests whether this client supports MCP scope step-up. Calling it should make your client ask you to re-authorize Strategy Hub with an extra scope. Safe; changes nothing.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders you can see, with your role and whether you can share each one. Folders come from slashes in document titles; access granted on a folder covers everything inside it.

tools.name: list_access
tools.description: Who can access a document or folder, and why (owner, direct grant, inherited folder grant, or workspace membership).

tools.name: grant_access
tools.description: Share a document or folder with a person by email (they must have a Strategy Hub account). Needs admin on that document/folder. Grants only add access; folder grants cover everything inside.

tools.name: revoke_access
tools.description: Remove a person's direct grant on a document or folder (see list_access for user ids). Access inherited from a parent folder or the workspace stays.

tools.name: rename_folder
tools.description: Rename a folder (needs edit access on everything inside). Document titles under it are updated; grants stay with the folder.

tools.name: move_folder
tools.description: Move a folder under another folder (or to the workspace root). Moving changes who can see its contents: they stop inheriting grants from the old parent and start inheriting from the new one.

tools.name: create_access_key
tools.description: Create a narrower access key to hand to a subagent or another tool. If you are using an access key, the new key is its child: it can never do more than your key (enforced by the database on every request) and revoking your key revokes it. If you are connected through OAuth (e.g. the Claude connector

tools.name: list_access_keys
tools.description: List the access key you are using and the keys created from it (scope and expiry; never the key itself).

tools.name: revoke_access_key
tools.description: Revoke an access key you created (and every key created from it). Takes effect on the next request.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_access_key" is 699 chars, far longer than this server's median (120). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Create a narrower access key to hand to a subagent or another tool. If you are using an access key, the new key is its child: it can never do more than your key…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_proposal, update_proposal, list_proposals, withdraw_proposal, create_access_key · Private data: list_documents, create_document, read_document, read_at_commit, commit_document, submit_proposal, update_proposal, list_proposals, list_versions, publish_version, document_history, rename_document, archive_document, unarchive_document, trash_document, restore_document, purge_document, delete_document, search_documents, add_document_comment, delete_document_comment, resolve_document_comment, read_workspace_context, list_folders, list_access, grant_access, revoke_access, rename_folder, create_access_key · Public sink: submit_proposal, publish_version, list_folders, grant_access, create_access_key · Destructive: archive_document, purge_document, delete_document, delete_document_comment, revoke_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_proposal, update_proposal, list_proposals, withdraw_proposal, create_access_key · Private data: list_documents, create_document, read_document, read_at_commit, commit_document, submit_proposal, update_proposal, list_proposals, list_versions, publish_version, document_history, rename_document, archive_document, unarchive_document, trash_document, restore_document, purge_document, delete_document, search_documents, add_document_comment, delete_document_comment, resolve_document_comment, read_workspace_context, list_folders, list_access, grant_access, revoke_access, rename_folder, create_access_key · Public sink: submit_proposal, publish_version, list_folders, grant_access, create_access_key · Destructive: archive_document, purge_document, delete_document, delete_document_comment, revoke_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
